scenes.line1: How do you keep Android apps responsive?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how top Android apps stay smooth and responsive? What keeps your async code safe from leaks?

scenes.label: Coroutine
scenes.sub: Lets you run async tasks without blocking the main thread.
scenes.say: Coroutines help you run background tasks without freezing the user interface.
Use viewModelScope for logic that needs to survive screen rotations. lifecycleScope is best for UI tasks that should end with the screen.
Pick Dispatchers.IO for heavy lifting, Main for UI updates. Flow streams data reactively, and only starts when collected.

scenes.question: How do you avoid blocking the main thread?
scenes.right: Launch coroutines with Dispatchers.IO for heavy tasks, then switch to Main for UI updates.
scenes.say: Don’t just launch everything in lifecycleScope. Use Dispatchers.IO for background work, then switch to Main for UI updates.
